acceptance: PROVISIONAL; RMS passes with median qualification; full-frame raster and browser verification complete; geographic and user acceptance remain false
limitations: Seven excluded checks give RMS 83.46 m, within the 100 m ceiling, but median 86.29 m exceeds 75 m. P95 is 116.39 m and maximum 119.06 m. The first result remains qualified.

Checks concentrate in northern lake systems and Bruin Lake. East Lake extends the controls southward but has no nearby independent check; the broad southern band and large-lake corridors remain insufficiently checked.

Bruin Lake supplies two controls and two checks, including opposite ends of one island. Little Seven Mile and Fraser also share their lake between control/check observations. High spatial correlation limits the strength of the regional accuracy evidence.
All observations use modern lake or lake-island boundaries and 12 px working source uncertainty. Whole-frame retention does not imply geographic acceptance.
